name: The Solar System Signal
tip: Explain a science idea in your own words. If you can teach it, you probably understand it.

questions.q: Which planet has the largest number of confirmed moons?
questions.why: Saturn currently has the most confirmed moons.

questions.q: What force keeps planets in orbit around the Sun?
questions.why: The Sun's gravity keeps planets moving in their orbits.

questions.q: Which layer of Earth is liquid and helps create its magnetic field?
questions.why: Movement in the liquid outer core helps generate Earth's magnetic field.
